nextStoryContext: US-006 is the switchover story: route run/next/plan commands through the internal launcher (launchClaude from US-004) instead of the external `claude-auto-retry` binary. Also adds src/util/retry-pid.ts for the monitor PID file at ~/.cam/retry.pid (write/read/liveness/remove). Check src/commands/run.ts, next.ts, plan.ts for `claude-auto-retry` usage via `grep -r claude-auto-retry src/commands/`. US-005's forkMonitor currently writes no PID file — that gap is filled by US-006's retry-pid.ts. The cleanup callback in forkMonitor (claude.ts) is a no-op stub for now; US-006 should wire in the retry-pid remove helper.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: `detached?: boolean` is in bun.d.ts (calls setsid() on POSIX so child outlives parent). `proc.unref()` exists on Subprocess and prevents parent event loop from waiting on child. stdio: ['ignore','ignore','ignore'] is valid (maps to [Writable, Readable, Readable] tuple). The docs webpage omitted `detached` but type definitions confirmed it. Implementation matches API.
